company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform designed to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration for software teams and enterprise organizations.
target_audience: Software engineers, developers, API teams, individual builders, and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform providing database, authentication, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings. It enables developers and enterprises to rapidly build, launch, and scale applications from prototypes to production.
target_audience: Developers, AI builders, startups, innovation teams, and enterprise organizations seeking a Postgres-backed developer platform for application development.

company_overview: Vapi is an open voice agent platform that allows developers and enterprise teams to build, deploy, and scale advanced voice AI agents. The platform manages infrastructure, orchestration, real-time monitoring, and integrations to rapidly move voice experiences from prompt to production.
target_audience: Developers, builders, and enterprise companies across industries like customer support, healthcare, and marketplace staffing looking to deploy scalable voice AI agents.
